### Fixed
- **A deleted platform Harness is recreated by the kagent release on its next reconcile** (giantswarm/agent-platform#409): the kagent HelmRelease carries `spec.driftDetection.mode: enabled` — on every reconcile (`gitops.interval`) helm-controller compares the release manifest with the cluster and re-applies what differs or is missing, as a server-side apply without a Helm revision. Without it a plain reconcile of the unchanged release reported "in-sync", and the Harness a consumer skipping 4.7.19 lost on the 4.8.0 upgrade stayed deleted — every template unadmitted, 600 s observed — until a forced reconcile. `components.<name>.driftDetection` is a passthrough for every component entry (HelmRelease v2 `spec.driftDetection`: `mode`, `ignore`), set for kagent only; `tests/verify-kagent-wiring.py` asserts it and that no other release carries one by default, and the ATS smoke deletes the Harness and sees it back on a requested (not forced) reconcile with both templates Ready and no revision written. UPGRADE.md's 4.8.0 note names the forced-reconcile recovery for an installation on 4.8.0 exactly; the customer BOM example pins the connectivity chart to the release it is published with.
